answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: new identities trade small amounts only until they complete real trades with 12 distinct established counterparties in 20 epochs. Sybil fakes only echo each other in a closed loop, never reaching 12 partners. Each trade carries a ferrous seal, so no history can be forged later. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 trades at 50 POA, 600,000 POA in all, while honest agents pay 12 normal trades and keep full earnings.
